sources.snippet: FLUX.1 [dev] LoRA is an image generation model developed by Black Forest Labs and released in August 2024. It is built on the FLUX.1 [dev] base model and extends it with support for LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) fine-tuning, allowing users to apply custom-trained style or subject adapters at inference time.
